It is frozen: no weight increase and no new EA use until the demo has 3 months of breakout trades. Judge it then against the tester (candidates.json expected_tester: 777 trades 2024.01-2026.09, about 24 a month, win 47%, PF 1.14). Pulling needs a demo EA change, so only the owner can do it.
